query:
SELECT timestamp,source,
CASE WHEN source='postgres_logs' THEN 'duplicate_key_query' WHEN startsWith(log_attributes['request.path'],'/storage/') THEN 'slow_storage' ELSE 'audit_http' END AS kind,
CASE WHEN source='postgres_logs' THEN CASE WHEN positionCaseInsensitive(log_attributes['parsed.query'],'order_assignment_logs')>0 THEN 'order_assignment_logs INSERT' ELSE 'other' END
WHEN position(log_attributes['request.path'],'/verifications/pickup/')>0 THEN 'pickup_verification'
WHEN position(log_attributes['request.path'],'/verifications/dropoff/')>0 THEN 'dropoff_verification'
WHEN position(log_attributes['request.path'],'/parcels/')>0 THEN 'parcel_booking_image'
WHEN startsWith(log_attributes['request.path'],'/storage/') THEN 'other_parcel_image'
ELSE 'order_assignment_logs' END AS flow,
log_attributes['response.status_code'] AS status,log_attributes['response.origin_time'] AS origin_ms,log_attributes['request.headers.content_length'] AS request_bytes
FROM logs
WHERE (source='postgres_logs' AND log_attributes['parsed.sql_state_code']='23505')
OR(source='edge_logs' AND log_attributes['request.method']='POST' AND (log_attributes['request.path']='/rest/v1/order_assignment_logs' OR(startsWith(log_attributes['request.path'],'/storage/') AND startsWith(log_attributes['request.headers.user_agent'],'Dart/') AND toFloat64OrZero(log_attributes['response.origin_time'])>5000)))
ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 15
